jobs.employer_name: Leibniz-Institut zur Analyse d es Biodiversitätswandels Stift ung des öffentlichen Rechts
jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for the Analysis of Biodiversity Change (LIB) is one of the large, globally connected research museums of the Leibniz Association. In addition to excellent research on biodiversity and its change, we are advancing the further development of our extensive scientific collections with an international team and state-of-the-art technology. With our exhibition, knowledge transfer and communication work at our exhibition venues Museum Koenig Bonn and Museum der Natur Hamburg, we want to spread enthusiasm for nature and contribute with our research topics to current socio-political discussions on species loss, climate change and the protection of ecosystems. The construction of an integrated natural history museum is being planned for the Hamburg location; the research infrastructure at the Bonn location is currently being significantly expanded.

Become part of our institute in Hamburg. We are looking for the next possible date, limited according to the WissZeitVG for three years a scientist for a position as

Curator Ornithology (m/f/d)

in full-time 39.00 hours/week, at LIB Hamburg, representing research at an internationally competitive level. The successful candidate will bring together the bird collection and ornithological research on biodiversity change in space and time.

The candidate’s scientific expertise should include collection-based ornithological research and must cover at least one of the following research fields:

- Systematics, taxonomy and phylogenetics
- Evolution of phenotypic traits
- Functional ecology
- Biogeography

With a preference for methodologies such as morphometrics, bioacoustics or phylogenomics

Your profile:

- a PhD in zoology, biology or related areas with a focus on ornithology,
- expertise in taxonomy and systematics in extant birds,
- hands-on working experience with natural history collections, especially birds,
- high quality publication record relative to opportunity
- track record of third-party funding relative to opportunity
- track record, or potential of developing a research group
- track record of team-work and collaboration
- demonstrate a vision for future research, collection development and third-party funding

Your tasks:

- Integrate into the Centre for Taxonomy and Morphology in Hamburg and play a strong role in advancing the LIB's reputation as a preeminent institution for the study of biodiversity change on a global scale.
- Conduct internationally recognised collection-based research and build a research group in Hamburg
- Assume full curatorial responsibility for the ornithological collection housed by LIB Hamburg, including preparing for and relocating the ornithological collection into the new museum building (projected building completion: 2030-2032)
- Additional curatorial duties such as collection management, provision of scientific services, expansion and digitization of the collection, and contributions to outreach activities.
- Promote and lead LIB-internal teamwork and external collaborations
- Forge collaborations within the LIB (Hamburg and Bonn)

We offer:

- An attractive position in an excellent research institution with a high degree of creative potential in a dynamic scientific and social environment. This is a tenure-track position, initially limited for three years according to the WissZeitVG. Starting remuneration will be in pay group E13 according to the TV-L. After a successful tenure evaluation, the candidate will be classified in TV-L E14.
- Remuneration according to the collective agreement of the federal states with all the benefits of the public sector (company pension scheme, annual special payment, capital-forming benefits, collectively agreed vacation entitlement)
- Family friendliness certified by the "Work and Family Audit", offer of life coaching through professional family service
- the possibility of obtaining a job ticket
- A centrally located workplace with excellent transport links

Please send your complete application documents in english (CV, certificates, lists of publications and funding) and a concept for leading the Ornithology section should be submitted, max. 10 MB per document) by August 30, 2026 exclusively digitally via our career portal: https://8101202752.karriereportal.cloud/ (https://8101202752.karriereportal.cloud/)  to Ms. Winkels. For organizational reasons, only online applications will be accepted.

The Leibniz Association is committed to diversity and gender equity. The LIB strives to create a diverse, inclusive, welcoming and positive work environment. We are certified as a family-friendly institution. We strongly encourage individuals from diverse backgrounds, identities and abilities to apply. We particularly aim to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are under-represented and to promote their careers. Severely disabled people will be given preference if equally qualified. You can find more information about our institution on the Internet at: https://leibniz-lib.de/ (https://leibniz-lib.de/)

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Project Procurement Manager, you represent Procurement in Project Management Teams, organizing all procurement activities within a project to optimize results. Your role is pivotal in ensuring implementing strategies to optimize project results and ensuring the quality, timely, and budgetary availability of Systems and Components.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Project Lead for Procurement in Execution Projects; Arrange the handover with the Proposal-PPM and initiate project-specific purchasing Kick Offs; Organize, monitor, and optimize all Procurement activities in a project
* Implement Procurement strategies to enhance project results
* Control project specifics sourcing processes to deliver optimum results in terms of budget, availability, timeline, and quality. Support project cost estimations with reliable and current cost data
* Analyze the scope of supply and contractual obligations, identifying risks, opportunities, changes throughout the project. Execute project specific Procurement strategies aligned with the Business Unit and Operating Company strategies
* Maintain communication with interface partners and ensure the best negotiation success together with the project buyers to meet the project targets. Manage the preferred supplier list and supplier qualifications for project execution phase
* Close Contact to Claim Management to clarify project specific claims to suppliers

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
* Long-term professional experience in procurement with a strong understanding of commercial, technical, project management, and international contract law.
* Interpersonal skills, thinking, creativity, drive, communication, intercultural competency, collaboration, negotiation, stakeholder & customer relationship management, problem-solving, data-driven decision-making, responsibility, and adaptability
* Advanced Digital, Technical & Functional Skills
* Excellent German and English language skills

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Windtunnel Test team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Windtunnel Testengineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Windtunnel Test team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Bremen
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €19.10 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

Your benefits

You combine a deep understanding of raw material markets in the energy sector, micro- and macroeconomic trends, with a structured, consulting-like approach—translating complexity into clear, actionable insights for the global Procurement community and key stakeholders.
You will monitor supply markets and act as a trusted advisor to Procurement (including senior leadership) and cross-functional stakeholders.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitoring and assessment of global supply markets, including raw materials, with identification of market risks, opportunities, and strategic scenarios to support business resilience and competitiveness
* Translation of market developments into actionable insights and business implications, enabling fact-based, data-driven decision-making across Procurement and the wider organization
* Continuous development and enhancement of the Supply Market Intelligence framework, including strategic scenario planning, market monitoring methodologies, and reporting dashboards
* Preparation and presentation of supply market intelligence to Procurement, senior management, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of key market developments and recommendations
* Leadership of strategic market intelligence initiatives and integration of market insights into procurement and supply chain strategies, processes, and decision-making combined with coordination of global cross-functional collaboration
* Implementation of digital, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of Supply Market Intelligence

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field
* Extensive professional experience in Supply Market Intelligence, Strategy, Procurement, Consulting, or related industries, preferably within energy, utilities, mining, or industrial manufacturing
* Strong analytical, strategic, and consulting capabilities, including structured problem-solving, hypothesis-driven thinking, and the translation of market insights into actionable business recommendations
* Proven project leadership and stakeholder management expertise, including ownership of cross-functional initiatives and effective engagement with senior management and international stakeholders
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence diverse audiences and foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a strong one-team mindset
* Experience in digitalization, data analytics, and technology implementation within market intelligence or procurement environments, combined with fluency in English, international exposure, and willingness to travel internationally and domestically (approximately 10–20%)

You will join a high-impact Supply Market Intelligence team within Corporate Procurement, shaping how Siemens Energy anticipates market developments and secures supply resilience. The team acts as a central intelligence and foresight hub, closely collaborating with the global Procurement community, Corporate Commodity Managers, and senior leadership to translate market complexity into actionable insights, strategic options, and measurable business impact.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As Project Lead for Network Detection & Response Evaluation, you will drive the selection and proof of concept validation of an Network Detection & Response solution and ensure it fits our Security Operations Center operating model and technical landscape. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, define success criteria, manage risks (e.g., performance, integration, compliance), and deliver a decision-ready recommendation including a roadmap from PoC to operational rollout.

Your tasks include the folliwing responsibilities:

- Leading the structured evaluation and selection of a Network Detection and Response solution, including requirements definition, vendor comparison, and decision preparation
- Planning and executing a proof of concept to validate detection capabilities, operational fit, and technical feasibility in a Security Operations Center environment
- Defining and aligning target use cases and success criteria for network-based threat detection and response, focusing on visibility gaps and anomaly detection
- Driving the integration concept into existing Security Operations Center tooling and processes, ensuring alignment with monitoring, investigation, and response workflows
- Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across cyber security, infrastructure, and network domains to ensure alignment on architecture, data sources, and deployment approach
- Evaluating the reuse and integration of existing network telemetry and sensor data to optimize cost, complexity, and time-to-value
- Developing and documenting a target operating model for network-based threat detection and response within cyber security operations
- Identifying and managing key project risks, including performance impact, integration complexity, resource constraints, and data protection requirements
- Preparing management-ready recommendations, including solution comparison, risk assessment, and roadmap towards implementation and operationalization

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in a related field or comparable qualification
- Proven experience in leading cyber security or information technology projects on enterprise level, ideally in evaluation or implementation of detection and monitoring capabilities.
- Strong understanding of network-based threat detection and response principles, including behavioral analytics and anomaly detection approaches.
- Practical knowledge of enterprise network environments and data sources within large-scale enterprise environments, such as network flow data and traffic analysis approaches.
- Experience working with Security Operations Center environments and related platforms, including monitoring, alerting, and incident handling processes.
- Demonstrated ability to design and execute structured evaluation processes and proof of concepts with clear success criteria.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.
- Solid understanding of compliance, governance, and data protection requirements in cyber security contexts
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

Advantageous

- Experience in integrating detection and monitoring solutions into complex enterprise environments, including cross-domain architectures.
- Background in threat hunting, detection engineering, or incident response.
- Familiarity with network and endpoint security technologies and their interaction within a holistic security architecture.
- Experience in environments combining information technology and operational technology with specific monitoring requirements.
- Relevant certifications in project management or cyber security.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Configuration Management Product Service Line Team in Hamburg, Airbus Commercial is looking for an

Conformity & Attestation SAP IT Architect (d/m/f)

The department is responsible for the development, implementation, maintenance and support of PLM solutions across Airbus programs in alignment with the companies digital strategy.

Your location
Hamburg-Finkenwerder is one of Airbus’ most important production sites and a central hub for commercial aircraft manufacturing. Located directly on the Elbe River, the site offers a dynamic international working environment where engineering, production and innovation come together to shape the future of aviation.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 dayspaid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Define the future architecture to set-up to implement the needs expressed by the business, and to drive the Conformity & Attestation transformation in sync with Airbus ERP Transformation project.
- Support the teams on a day to day basis (in line with Safe methodology)
- Be the technical referent of the DPCA team on SAP technology: propose simple solutions, maintainable, and share technical knowledge with the DPCA team.
- Act as a focal point with ERP CoE (DE organisation).
- Note that this position does not include System activities, as they are managed by the ERP CoE.
- Perform some technical audit of the teams’ deliverables, ensuring quality golden rules are followed.
- Contribute to the local network, working in close collaboration with the Conformity and Attestation perimeter such as manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, shopfloor, and in particular with the Conformity & Attestation ITOps from DPCA team
- Identify local business specificities and support the C&A team (located in Airbus Toulouse, Hamburg and Bangalore) to deliver in line with local business needs.
- Ensure appropriate resolution of Conformity & Attestation incidents:
- Be able to support the ITOps’ team for the resolution of production incidents
- Contribute to on-duty periods (about 1 week every 6 to 8 weeks, to be shared with the team)

Applications used in our perimeter :

- Main platforms used by C&A tools: SAP (PAC, PEA, PDA, PGI, PHL).
- Main C&A applications: CAIR, AIR, DAIR, Traceability, mySI, E2E CA Reallocation, myGaps
- Other applications used for daily job: MOPO, MyPortfolio, Servicenow, Agility, APS, ACS, PLM Info Center, DP Dashboard, etc)

Desired skills and qualifications

- Team spirit and stakeholder management (communicate & influence)
- Ability to work autonomously
- Good knowledge of SAP, in particular following tools: CAIR, AIR, mySI, E2E CA Reallocation
- Know of Airbus tools is appreciated: APS, ACS, PDM tools, ARP
- Experience on the following domain is appreciated: Configuration Management, Conformity, Attestation, Traceability, Special Instruction, CA Reallocation, Logistics
- English mandatory, German recommended, French appreciated
- Knowledge of Safe methodology is appreciated
- Adaptability
- Customer minded
- Availability to work under pressure when A/C deliveries have to be secured

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the A320 Family VSM (Value Stream Management) Industrial Evolution, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Internship within VSM Industrial Evolution (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Data Scientist (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the A320 Family VSM (Value Stream Management) Industrial Evolution as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: August 2026
- Duration: 3-6 months

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S SHAPING THE FUTURE OF AIRCRAFT PRODUCTION!

Are you ready to take your next big step and dive into the world of industrial evolution? Look no further, because we’ve got the perfect opportunity for an intern at Airbus for an exclusive project!

We are a global team at the heart of the A320 Family production, and we’re on a mission to revolutionize how things are done. Specifically, we focus on the critical phase of fuselage assembly. You'll be helping us map out the future of aircraft production by integrating state-of-the-art measurement systems across our Final Assembly Lines (FALs). If you're a go-getter with a passion for precision, problem-solving, and working with a highly motivated team, you’re in the right place!

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Get precise! You will dive deep into the world of measurement systems within our fuselage assembly, supporting the setup, testing, and evaluation of high-precision metrology tools.
- Crunch some numbers! You’ll collect, structure, analyze, and visualize measurement data that drives real change in how we align and join aircraft sections.
- Become a precision ninja! Help us optimize measurement concepts, evaluate tolerances, and ensure all fuselage components fit together like clockwork.
- Unleash your creativity! We want your input on automating data analysis and simplifying our measurement processes, so the fun stuff gets more focus.
- Show your skills! Present your findings in our weekly team meetings—you’ll be a key part of the conversation, not a coffee runner.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You’re enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in something awesome like Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metrology (Messtechnik), Industrial Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
- Got some skills? If you’ve dabbled in 3D measurement technologies, laser tracking, CAD, or data analytics, that’s a massive plus!
- Languages! Fluent in English and German? Perfect! French? Even better!
- A proactive attitude and a talent for making sense of chaos—able to structure your work, handle highly precise data, and communicate results effectively.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.
